text: 12 cup Mr. Coffee carafe. You just cannot beat a Mr. Coffee product :) Carafe was in fine condition and delivered right on time. Im a very happy coffee drinker.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee Replacement 12-Cup Glass Carafe, White -
features: Fits Mr. Coffee AMX, MV, CG, DW, SK, VB, EHX, SJX and JWX series coffee machines
description: When it comes time to replace your glass coffee carafe—whether it's broken, or stained, or you're just ready to make a change—the Mr. Coffee Replacement 12-Cup Glass Carafe is your go-to. It's designed to keep your freshly brewed coffee hot, and when you're ready for a cup, its large handle and angled spout ensures a steady, mess-free pour.
